A populated terrestrial '''moon''' was located in the [[Werta system/Legends|Werta system]],<ref name="GaW" /> a part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Oriolan sector/Legends|Oriolan sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established a large [[Unidentified Rebel base (Werta system moon)|base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. Shortly after the base's establishment, it was discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="GaW" />

{{RPGseed}}
Intending to capitalize on the rare and tempting opportunity presented by the base's discovery, and despite the rumors that the find could be a cunning bait for an Alliance trap, the Empire carefully planned an [[assault on the Werta system moon]]. An Imperial [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]] was used to interdict [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] travel to and from the [[Star system/Legends|star system]], after which the moon housing the Rebel base was subjected to a concerted attack. During the assault, the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] neutralized the base's defenses and took Rebel [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].<ref name="GaW" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Werta system moon was mentioned in the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy at War]]'', which was published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. Within that book, the moon was mentioned in an adventure seed for use with the ''Star Wars Roleplaying Game''. This article assumes that scenario plays out as described.<ref name="GaW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the 2009 reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Werta system, and therefore the moon, in grid square J-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
